[size=4]Description[/size]
This mod provides the player with an additional menu listing other multiplayer farmhands with their location, allowing the player to warp to their position.
Warp button will only show if the friend is online. Press J to open menu (changeable inside config.json or options menu).

[b][size=4]Features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Menu list of all created farmhands w/ location 
[*]Warp button for online players
[*]Config menu
[/list]
[size=4]Working On... [/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Chat commands[/size]
[*][size=2]Usable by clients (no mod needed)[/size]
[/list]
[b]Note! - Requires latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/b]

[b][size=4]Install[/size] [/b]
[list=1]
[*]Make sure you have SMAPI installed
[*]Extract the .zip and place the folder inside StardewValley/Mods folder
[*]Run the game with SMAPI
[/list]
